subject: Are you ready to elect a Democrat in Texas?

body:
here are the latest developments...
#
Peter,
There have been some major developments out of Texas recently, so today we wanted to get you up to speed on the latest.
Here’s what you need to know:
**FIRST – As soon as James Talarico became the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Texas, the GOP started pummeling him with attacks.** They know his message is already resonating with voters across the state, so they’re doing everything they can to tear him down.

subject: Thank You for Believing in Our Campaign!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Canepa for Assessor-County Clerk-Recorder 2026 committee, ID #1486383**
body:

| | |
---
| Friends,

As the votes continue to be counted, I am humbled and grateful by the support our campaign has received throughout San Mateo County.

While this campaign carried my name, this victory belongs to all of us.

I want to sincerely thank every person who played a role in this journey. Thank you to the voters who placed their trust in me. Thank you to our donors whose generosity helped us share our message. Thank you to our volunteers who walked precincts, made phone calls, sent text messages, hosted events, and spent countless hours helping our campaign reach voters across the county. Thank you to my family and friends whose encouragement and support sustained me through every step of this race.

This campaign was built around a commitment to protecting our elections, ensuring fair and accurate property assessments, modernizing public records, and providing outstanding service to the people of San Mateo County. Together, we shared a vision of an Assessor-County Clerk-Recorder-Chief Election Officer's Office that is accessible, transparent, efficient, and worthy of the public's trust.

The campaign trail brought me into neighborhoods and communities throughout the county, where I had the opportunity to listen to residents, hear their concerns, and learn from their experiences. Those conversations reinforced why public service matters and why local government can make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

I am especially grateful for the confidence you have placed in me. Serving the people of San Mateo County is a responsibility I do not take lightly. I am committed to working every day to earn your trust and to build an office that residents can be proud of.

Thank you for believing in this campaign, for believing in public service, and for believing in the future of San Mateo County.

I look forward to serving you and getting to work.

With gratitude,
David Canepa
Assessor-County Clerk-Recorder-Chief Election Officer Elect
San Mateo County

name: Chris Pappas
subject: I’d be the first gay man in the U.S. Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
My community showed me what’s possible.
| When I was a kid, reading this kind of headline would have been unimaginable, friend: [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/111167?t=6&akid=24871%2E878179%2ENveGNo) Growing up as a gay person in New Hampshire, I never imagined I could live out — let alone run for U.S. Senate. **But my community showed me what's possible.** You helped me win _four times_ in one of the most competitive congressional districts in the country.

We’ve made tremendous progress since I was younger. But there’s still something we’ve never done. **We’ve never elected a gay man to the Senate.**

To be clear I’m not running for Senate just to make history. I’m in this race for the people of New Hampshire –** _all of us_**. But the prospect of moving the needle of progress forward is deeply meaningful to me.

This is an opportunity for representation in the Senate. It’s also important that LGBTQ+ people have more seats at the table at a time when our rights are coming under attack.

**We can win this election for the people of New Hampshire, charting a path forward for our shared future – and we can tear down barriers and make history at the same time.**

[Will you split a $10 contribution between my campaign and Voter Protection Project right now to stand with me in this historic fight?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/111167?t=7&akid=24871%2E878179%2ENveGNo)

**Thank you for supporting me in this campaign, friend.** No matter who you are, who you love, who you pray to, or where you're from — know that I'll always have your back.

With gratitude,

Chris

But there’s still something we’ve never done. We’ve never elected a gay man to the Senate. To be clear I’m not running for Senate just to make history. I’m in this race for the people of New Hampshire – all of us. But the prospect of moving the needle of progress forward is deeply meaningful to me. This is an opportunity for representation in the Senate. It’s also important that LGBTQ+ people have more seats at the table at a time when our rights are coming under attack. We can win this election for the people of New Hampshire, charting a path forward for our shared future – and we can tear down barriers and make history at the same time. Thank you for supporting me in this campaign, friend. No matter who you are, who you love, who you pray to, or where you're from — know that I'll always have your back. With gratitude, Chris 878179 | | Paid for by VPP (www.protectvoting.org) Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. 401 2nd Ave. S, Ste. 303, Seattle, WA 98104 The Voter Protection Project is on an important mission: To end partisan gerrymandering and voter suppression by electing candidates at the state and federal levels that are forceful advocates for voting rights. GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE

Friend,

I want to start with two simple words.

Thank you.

Thank you for caring about children you may never meet.

Thank you for believing that every child has value and for refusing to accept a world where innocent children can be bought and sold.

Because that is exactly what is happening.

Every day.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDB9AAwAAAAAAQ3QllWei5tjwonFjqP50TFBvMdpPlOzJ4Q6AjA7QGkE1a98DDzF1dk-W4e-b1o2lB2D2lutRzfsBaW3WZMaTy2PqDocaXd1iSwJWXN2xA

God's children are not for sale.

And today, I'd like to send you a shirt that boldly declares that truth.

When you make your first gift to the Sound of Freedom Foundation today, we'll send you a FREE white "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDB9AAwAAAAAAQ3QllWfowFZ2830LQowAl6VcK6T4QjL-_M0_22LCWEj4Kdz2CeXh_Iyx_VALz2dqPAsVSWWXajlFpNDRzzb6dzLphzoivuy61zUnwSdww

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDB9AAwAAAAAAQ3QllWgblLpb7cITy90-3kcKrmu2W_i3HjSeAsv2LxAsj0pVy4lIDAtsjrycG8txRxbw4W4z1lmgNdp31bBfR2xUa-kiNfYxbx9056hZw

This isn't a shirt you'll find in a store.

You can't buy it online.

It was created exclusively for supporters of the Sound of Freedom Foundation.

People who believe children deserve safety, refuse to look away and are willing to stand up and say:

"No more."

Every time you wear it, you'll be sharing a message that matters.

A message that reminds the world that every child has God-given dignity.

And importantly, a message that sparks conversations and helps raise awareness about a crisis many people still do not see.

Most of all Friend, I hope this shirt reminds you that you are part of something bigger than yourself.

A growing movement of people determined to protect vulnerable children.

Please accept this shirt as our way of saying thank you for joining this mission.

Give any amount today and choose your shirt size and select a color.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDB9AAwAAAAAAQ3QllWh_82ojJD_A7aGSvPWyXEkriWQj7a4cyzZ0kENyy6aiKc-JhaykXJP3dS_NhFEc4EY83I3v9R9FkyVD4fnuVedkgmUlXFUU4cjRQ
Protect God's Children Today

Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me.

My name is Eduardo Verástegui.

Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart.

Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed.

I couldn't forget it.

I couldn't stay silent.

I kept asking myself one question:

"What if it were my child?"

That question changed my life.

What started as a film project became a mission and a calling.

That calling eventually led me to help produce the film Sound of Freedom.

Not for fame.
Not for awards.
But because I believed people needed to see the truth.

For years, many people said the film would never succeed.

Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up.

But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.

And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough.

That is why we created the Sound of Freedom Foundation.

Our mission is simple:

To stop the sale of God's children.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDB9AAwAAAAAAQ3QllWijWkGNu2BxMo96Us_wb5AA25v6WuApjhafxUfq2sny_z8sTYP971In_8ebkj_PJw4vQV7qekSejp_D6KU13cYnvAXMNJsrvMTFQ
Protect God's Children Today

Every day, vulnerable children are targeted by traffickers who prey on poverty, instability, loneliness, and fear.

And every day, we work to fight back.

Jesus said,

"Let the little children come to me, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14)

Every child is precious in God's eyes.

Every child is created with dignity, purpose, and worth.

And every child deserves someone willing to stand up and fight for them

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDB9AAwAAAAAAQ3QllWj7943HnlIxpTZx6NSmG38DnJgO_4UDcZGeZa52wONpyGBgIbkPubpY43gCA2b4ipBlYqn6pVRlDHtvZVuxPhKjhtmq7qLdTjIWw

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDB9AAwAAAAAAQ3QllWkIG14cXH1hmNP9rZEtMXgX0REDoB7RKsFcD1UZa0XOY0wRe6gHfs5fdmk_8CjQDjSFUq74MBhqcvlkti4yG00ayqrkZqVMiKDsA
Protect God's Children Today

When you make your first gift today, you help:

- Prevent exploitation by helping strengthen vulnerable families before traffickers can prey on children.

- Support intervention efforts by equipping trusted partners working to help rescue children trapped in exploitation.

- Educate parents and communities about the warning signs traffickers use to target children.

- Raise awareness so more people understand the reality of this crisis.

- Advocate for stronger protections for vulnerable children and greater accountability for traffickers.

This is how change happens.

One person refuses to ignore the suffering, refuses to stay silent, and chooses to fight for a child they may never meet.

Today, that person can be you.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDB9AAwAAAAAAQ3QllWlchUs-kZLY4_CsAL1HOFDvmBGhlzSrQ0_tgXxRwnqgBlDNi2ORr6iWLXR4CzO9I8Mz6GTGgxYnKkB98vFVM8LJF1bi9y7HDMAgQ
Protect God's Children Today

Will you make your first gift now?

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MDB9AAwAAAAAAQ3QllWmPpcoFBRUcE1f_wpNnHf35QKERcMDPuXnT35iT9DudNgPY0N1uDmm406bT_rmzbiBDoKzBSJHphCPBlfrYahSgDprnEtv0nkVeQ
Please make your most generous gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can today to help protect vulnerable children from exploitation and trafficking.

Choose your shirt size and select a color.

And know that your generosity will help protect vulnerable children and bring hope to those who need it most.

Thank you for caring and for standing with vulnerable children.

Thank you for choosing action over silence.

With gratitude and prayer,

Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation

Help us keep sanity in the Senate!

| The Most Anticipated Race of 2026
Peter,
The 2026 Senate race in Maine is already making national headlines, and the stakes have never been higher.
The presumed Democratic nominee, Graham Platner, has taken this race in a dark direction. He is a radical, America-hating extremist. We cannot hand over a crucial Senate seat to a wild, angry oysterman who pushes a dangerous fringe agenda.
That is exactly why Susan Collins is receiving unprecedented bipartisan support. Mainers and Americans across the country realize that we need common-sense leadership in the Senate, not radical chaos.
But national extreme Left groups are already watching this race heat up, and they will do whatever it takes to defeat Susan. If we do not build our defenses right now, we risk losing everything we have worked for.
You are the only thing standing between common sense and a total radical takeover.

[If we don't fight back immediately, their narrative will be the only one voters see when they open their phones or laptops.](https://trk.email.goprelease._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTQ1JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDYwN19XRC1RTC4xMTQ1MTBfdDE5MTY1NjMtMTE0MiZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjA2MDdfV0QtUUwuMTE0NTEwX3QxOTE2NTYzLTExNDImeGlkPVYxLnVVOFBvLWdDYmlTQ1hjUnRrbjM1VjRsc2RZWFRZbVp4eldyZW1WQ2hmdk9oWFRDNlY4Vlg2QnExU2tQeGxGdVYifQ/3OYG7b3WCLlSMRicXMtw_Q)

## US Strikes Iran after Intercepting Drones
U.S. forces [struck Iranian coastal radar sites](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAQRU8DmZGxje0JHGxCNptuiGqgDN4xpuUqGvXtV3SwF5ikglfS0___z-f0CSmnsv6GHQPHYyp4UUZmrNNJxDV9I6UK5QLaUln5KJQnJZUV0grppgVSfk2mXUJEVKhbDL3z0ivrP4Z2C9H4Hu3QKwA96Bm8sdrB7Kx2Hx6cbVO4bdJK10vpe9OpLxeVNqCGQXmjoTESl8RH7f4eqfCGMb-OJ9ZuPvY2h435QY3-1aixUeN1Xd1cvub72ajxVjdqlP_PSQKYYf4mcbdKUAQlRhIQGeubiQxnmTcksdSjIIl0I0ZisZ45ipihojgf3cZ7bmtYHlfKOZF1jZHrDim_k_GP5nwG9S8AAP__5AiJvw) on Saturday after shooting down drones launched by Iran toward regional traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. **Whatever happened to Mark Spitz?** Mark Spitz is one of the greatest athletes of the 20th century, a swimmer who peaked so spectacularly that his story has two distinct halves: his improbable triumph in the 1972 Munich Olympics, and then the long, sometimes awkward process of being a living legend. He was in the water before he could really walk, and by age 10 he held 17 national age-group records. The destination always seemed obvious. But getting there wasn't. Spitz arrived at the 1968 Mexico City Games loudly predicting six gold medals and left with two relay golds and a bruised ego. The humiliation turned out to be the best thing that ever happened to him. Four years later in Munich, he entered seven events over eight days and won every single one, setting a world record each time. [You can see highlights here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwjAQxvGncTaiyzk4YfCAhJA60LWj5SRnctTEKD5i0aev6Ct0_T7pN_y_Lu7iOfJy_fR3shKSW6jkSCK0umfOsvI3ZV79UnyeeblKWnJ0CGh2YHbQuclzfLm2mmwgQtIV2abroUfTH_bVbJtx9GHqsQPS3sOgBw1NGBHHyRxMgIrtWwMDXQPQN22NQxdQtx73e-xb7VULNLGktb4lXmSmEF9po7Ue072KdhZ5ZKWPCs8Kz6WU-pWe8hzo_b8XL-Os9HlT-vQhx9vPaTvcHFSrnR6FY-RsOtXC9e45_pHyrw6bxd8AAAD__8BwceE). Afterwards, the [photograph of him in his swimsuit](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGSpCAUgOHTYKaFT0E6INjErDfd0KLloW8bwYI3bfWcfmrmCnOB_6_6_t2Xu6NIafvrDrQc8pLwqhGZsSwftXKhJ1YqLl2u7pQ2zqnGBSToVupWTot3FN_L2HgbEAGHBm0_GWlAm5tqduuU96ofDJhw65Wb-qBXrxAfPoSbnkJD9rsmtZx6KU0_dvCYAgyjA6XAjIMTo0RPnEv3P1PiHUN85xeWbs1HE-3OfFYx_BEwC5hpzYlWOtyGtUvIAuZzz5wFzJyr1Ko9XHm29ST-bC_ivT3Qu1gFzE2x_rwoRqp6EqPcDkfxZ8K_knlZ-AoAAP__UT547w), seven medals draped around his neck, became the best-selling sports poster of the decade. America couldn't get enough of swimmer Mark Spitz. Then came the awkward part. He was 22, absurdly famous, and everyone wanted a piece of him: razor commercials, milk campaigns, [TV variety shows](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFy6yAQgOHToM6a1YIEKiheo84vZUoNMotFjIQH1lZ8-4xzhdT_zFf8n-f57GKK-_W_28hyyPNOR03ETGV-1Mol3qjG4vbD1TXuV857TTMCDicYTqBn72J6zarxNhAhyYZspw0YHMzYN6s16jL6xSjQQQevR2mGzi1S9f7iO4CxifatwQC6AzCdanHRAaVy2PdolHRCAfnIubRfOe68Ukiv_KTSXvLWJLsy36uQ_wROAqfjONpXfvBjoXcXONU1F64CJ6lUgNv27T9MU6y_HzGlWActFFw3F9Ovx3-a8LT4EwAA___1C3Bf), a Hollywood career that critics politely destroyed. He made $7 million in two years and later admitted he hadn't been remotely prepared for any of it. He retreated into real estate in Beverly Hills, did some Olympic commentary for ABC, and tried one last comeback at 41, falling two seconds short of qualifying for Barcelona in 1992. It was an easy effort to mock, but in fact, Spitz had cracked the world top 30 in his sport at middle age. Today, [at 76, Spitz lives quietly](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OqzAQxfGngc7IDObjFi5uQ5dtt0STeIDZGBvZk1jZp19lX2Hrn3SO9P-8LBdkz2H7wIOsrHEJVLInEUrLI2dJfKfMCUPBvHPYJIbsF9AwKD0oPS4O2b8WUzu7EgF1Ndl2nPQEw_Svr3erp6GD3kF_w6sh07nVOWi1GQ31V3B9zfa9pgc9tlpPrWngOq7QGYS-h8l0WBlNjiWm5itykJ1W_4pPSs0tHrW3u8iZq-5_BXMFcyml2dIjbPTmCmYzmM5Mb9lR6ElJ7XieFMgpieqRUeXCx8FhU1kwqQPTXeWT5buCuU7WnYW95zyMldHbgex_f-VPsZ4WfgIAAP__mtl-1w) in Los Angeles with his wife, Suzy; his two sons live nearby. He gives motivational speeches, stays connected to the swimming world, and holds a place in history that even Olympic legend Michael Phelps could only partially dislodge. _Did you see Mark Spitz in the Olympics? Mark Spitz is one of the greatest athletes of the 20th century, a swimmer who peaked so spectacularly that his story has two distinct halves: his improbable triumph in the 1972 Munich Olympics, and then the long, sometimes awkward process of being a living legend. He was in the water before he could really walk, and by age 10 he held 17 national age-group records. The destination always seemed obvious. But getting there wasn't. Spitz arrived at the 1968 Mexico City Games loudly predicting six gold medals and left with two relay golds and a bruised ego. The humiliation turned out to be the best thing that ever happened to him. Four years later in Munich, he entered seven events over eight days and won every single one, setting a world record each time. . Afterwards, the , seven medals draped around his neck, became the best-selling sports poster of the decade. America couldn't get enough of swimmer Mark Spitz. Then came the awkward part. He was 22, absurdly famous, and everyone wanted a piece of him: razor commercials, milk campaigns, , a Hollywood career that critics politely destroyed. He made $7 million in two years and later admitted he hadn't been remotely prepared for any of it. He retreated into real estate in Beverly Hills, did some Olympic commentary for ABC, and tried one last comeback at 41, falling two seconds short of qualifying for Barcelona in 1992. It was an easy effort to mock, but in fact, Spitz had cracked the world top 30 in his sport at middle age. Today, in Los Angeles with his wife, Suzy; his two sons live nearby. He gives motivational speeches, stays connected to the swimming world, and holds a place in history that even Olympic legend Michael Phelps could only partially dislodge. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | Today's Top Pick (ads) | • | Salem Media Group ---|--- • | Research Boulevard • | Weiss Ratings Plus | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. **Good Morning!** On this day in 1911, gospel singer [Silas Roy Crain](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1ugzAUxfGngS3IH2DjwUMWtnTJ0NEy-JJcydjIvg3h7av0FTof6Xek__fN3TxGTI8vv4Gl95pdgqNGIILi6lLgOHLZKiaCVHE9ay51Pp1gQl2YujDtgsd4ur4NdmbB8BYs1yMbJeNctk-rxMwWbbQcpF6MVNDPoxxMr41fDfCxRfvBmGKac8YH0YVFzSIIY8ZhMJzppmcQkHLp6AkEb1_XeOYXlG7JWxvtk2ivjbw2YmrElHcfkyfMqX72RkwrRqiNmO75J7o7YSlQqsvJXaMPAVO3h7UtNuwHxohVfQ4fm8f459P_qrys-A0AAP__SmJ4AA) was born in San Augustine. name: Mark Kelly
subject: This wasn’t the plan.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
Team, when Gabby and I first agreed that I would run for Senate back in 2019, we knew things would change. We know more than most how public service can change your life.
But I’ve got to tell you, I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be threatened with a court-martial by the Secretary of Defense, or to have the President of the United States calling for my execution.
Look, I don’t want you to worry about me. I’ve been through a lot in my life, and things like this don’t intimidate me all that much.
I do worry that Trump might succeed at intimidating others, though. Like people just beginning to get involved, or thinking about joining a peaceful demonstration, or speaking out at a town hall. I worry Trump and his cronies are trying to scare people out of resisting him.
But then I see millions of people meeting this moment with the courage and resolve it demands of them. People like my friend Chris Pappas. It makes me hopeful, sure. But more than that, it makes me incredibly proud.
We’re ready to fight like hell to save our democracy. If you’re with me, please:
**[Split a donation between me and Chris Pappas. $5 or anything you can afford.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260607_1.G5j0f4&refcode=em20260607-1&t=1&akid=7035%2E582294%2EXU3B2y)**

Thanks so much,
Mark

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2463%2E135344%2EMnXUTa)
Friends -
It's almost another FEC fundraising deadline - one of the last of the election - and that means if you're anything like me you're seeing non-stop requests for money from political campaigns and organizations. And as you have likely seen, there are some striking similarities in these emails and the tactics they use:
There's the 3x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-26.79HKre&refcode=em260311&t=2&akid=2463%2E135344%2EMnXUTa)
The 5x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-26.79HKre&refcode=em260311&t=3&akid=2463%2E135344%2EMnXUTa)
And even the 10x match!
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-26.79HKre&refcode=em260311&t=4&akid=2463%2E135344%2EMnXUTa)
Here's the thing: none of that is real. No one is matching donations. They are trying to trick people into donating. It's cynical, and it's something we're never going to do here.
But we do have very real June fundraising goals -- and the money we raise between now and this FEC fundraising deadline will go toward helping me elect Democrats in key races here in Michigan, and in other parts of the country I've been asked to come in and help campaign.
Almost all of the donations we receive to fund that important work comes from people giving smaller donations — often in response to emails like this one. Which means from time to time, as much as I wish I did not have to, I have to ask.
And while I don't expect you to donate to every email we send, I hope that you will contribute to this one. It would mean a lot.
[**With all that in mind, can you please use this link to contribute $3, or whatever you can afford today? There's no matching donation, no super-donor ready to 10x your contribution—but it will help ensure we win a number of important races in Michigan and other parts of the country where candidates believe I can help make a difference for them.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-26.79HKre&refcode=em260311&t=5&akid=2463%2E135344%2EMnXUTa)

| | Friend, Despite the obvious clues that something wasn’t right in Minnesota, the mainstream media – in their typical fashion – intentionally ignored what eventually became one of the year’s biggest stories. Even when reports about massive fraud tied to taxpayer-funded childcare programs started surfacing, _most legacy outlets barely touched it._ The story was complicated, politically uncomfortable, and easy for the national media to quietly overlook. **But independent journalist Nick Shirley didn’t overlook it.** He grabbed a camera, went to the locations reported to be receiving taxpayer money, knocked on doors, and documented what he found: Facilities receiving large sums of taxpayer funding that appeared empty. Serious questions about where the money was actually going. And a story that suddenly millions of Americans couldn’t ignore. His investigation _exploded_ online. Members of Congress started asking questions. And a scandal that had been quietly buried was forced into the national spotlight. **That’s the power of independent journalism, and it’s exactly why Lincoln Media Foundation exists.** Lincoln Media Foundation (LMF) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to exposing media bias and making sure critical stories don’t disappear just because powerful institutions would rather they did. We fund independent journalism, partner with citizen reporters, and use a growing digital media network to amplify stories the mainstream press ignores. **[Right now, that includes supporting Nick Shirley and the investigative work he’s continuing across the country.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**

Independent journalists don’t have billion-dollar newsrooms behind them. On top of this, the mainstream media, leftist politicians, and the corrupt individuals Nick is exposing are all working to discredit him and bury the harsh truths he is uncovering. **That’s why Lincoln Media Foundation is asking for your help today. That’s why supporting organizations like the National Democratic Redistricting Committee is so important. Keeping track of and fighting back against Republican attacks on fair representation is literally our job. Here are the states where Republicans have redrawn maps — but this fight is far from over. Florida | Republicans approved a partisan gerrymander that blatantly violates the state's constitution and could lead to **4 additional Republican seats.**
Louisiana | Lawmakers canceled their election to pass a new, egregious map eliminating a majority-Black district — a chance for **1 additional Republican seat.**
Missouri | Republicans carved up Kansas City to deliberately take away Black voting power — a chance for **1 additional Republican seat.**
North Carolina | The GOP passed a new gerrymander, dismantling a Black district — an opportunity for **1 additional Republican seat.**
Ohio | Lawmakers approved a gerrymander on top of another gerrymander that improves their chance for up to **2 additional Republican seats.**
Tennessee | The General Assembly passed an extreme gerrymander eight days after the Supreme Court ruling — it would eliminate the state's only majority-Black district and could lead to **1 additional Republican seat.**
Texas | They kicked off the redistricting crisis last summer — passing a racial gerrymander that could lead to 5**additional Republican seats.**

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

The Democratic establishment wants you to believe that defeating a
longtime incumbent is impossible.

But the truth is, Justice Democrat Darializa Avila Chevalier has a real
path to victory in her primary race against incumbent Rep. Adriano
Espaillat in NY-13. That’s why we’ve launched a new ad to reach voters
across her district in these final weeks before the election:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260607-1-dac.pWoxwD&refcode=em20260607-37876&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37876%2E1203867%2E_rxR-X ]Ryan Grim: After recruiting @DarializaforNY to challenge Adriano
Espaillat in NY13, Justice Dems is putting $250k behind this ad, bringing
their total spend close to $400k.

This ad lays out exactly why we’re proud to stand behind Darializa. While
Espaillat claims he’s “for our community,” his record tells a different
story.

He said he “trusts the Trump administration” to follow the law when
unlawfully detaining Mahmoud Khalil, something it’s failed to do time and
time again. He backed Trump’s agenda and voted for $7.6 billion for ICE
funding. He takes massive checks from MAGA donors, ICE contractors, AIPAC,
and real estate developers — the same powerful interests that have made
life unaffordable for working people.

New Yorkers can’t afford more of Espaillat’s failed leadership. Meanwhile,
Darializa is one of us.

She has spent her career helping reunite families and supporting community
members targeted by the legal system. She’s fighting to abolish ICE, stand
up to landlords squeezing working families, and put affordability first
for the people of New York.

Following Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s victory, New Yorkers have proven they’re
ready for bold, unapologetic progressive leadership. Darializa is prepared
to bring that same vision to Congress — and now, with Zohran’s
endorsement, her momentum is only growing stronger.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260607-1-dac.pWoxwD&refcode=em20260607-37876&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=37876%2E1203867%2E_rxR-X ]The polls show this race is winnable,
Peter — but we can’t do it on momentum alone.
Can you pitch in $10 to Justice Democrats and Darializa
Avila Chevalier’s campaign today to help us send another member of our
2026 slate to Congress?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260607-1-dac.pWoxwD&refcode=em20260607-37876&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1022&akid=37876%2E1203867%2E_rxR-X ]Contribute $10

Just like all of our Justice Democrats, Darializa doesn’t take a dime from
corporate PACs and relies on grassroots power to move her campaign
forward.

Turning the energy behind our movement into a win takes real resources to
expand our outreach and make sure we can turn out every voter possible to
get her over the finish line.

That’s why we appreciate anything you can contribute today to fuel our
fight to elect Darializa and achieve a future we can afford.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

CHIP IN RIGHT NOW!
| Peter,
There is a stark difference between a Maine work ethic and a Washington political stunt.
The Radical Left's poster boy, Graham Platner, has plenty of time to pose for magazine covers and sit for glowing interviews with the New York Times.
Why? Because he simply isn't working.
He claims to be a "working-class oyster farmer," but the reality is far different. For the past decade, Platner has not held a full-time job. He has been passively growing oysters and enjoying a leisurely life, all while Chuck Schumer and Elizabeth Warren prop him up as their handpicked candidate to flip Maine blue. Now, he is bending the truth in glossy photo shoots, trying to convince voters that he will work hard for our state.
Mainers know what real hard work looks like.
Compare Platner's record to Susan Collins'. Susan has never missed a roll call vote. She has never taken a sick day. She has never stopped fighting for Maine's interests in Washington.
It is glaringly evident that Graham Platner lacks the work ethic that defines our state. If Schumer's millions successfully buy this seat, Maine will be represented by a part-time politician who cares more about his media profile than our communities.
We cannot let the Radical Left deceive Maine voters with a fabricated image. We need the resources to expose Platner's true record before it is too late.

body:
Growing up I never imagined this future was possible, Peter.
Peter, Chris Pappas here. **Happy Pride! 🏳️🌈**
So much has changed since I was a kid. I remember hearing so much derogatory language used against gay people – some directed at me before I even knew who I was.
When I came out in college, I was lucky to have a family that supported me unconditionally. More and more Granite Staters ascribe to a live-and-let-live philosophy. They want their neighbors to be able to live freely and be who they are. That’s why **New Hampshire was one of the first states to support marriage equality.**
But the Trump Administration has been relentlessly attacking the LGBTQ+ community – taking away vital mental health resources and supporting discriminatory laws. I’m running for Senate to represent all Granite Staters — and while, if elected, I would be the first out gay man in the Senate, this campaign is about fighting for everyone.
We’re going to lower costs, protect health care access, and stand up to a reckless administration that’s coming after everyone. It would be an honor to have you by my side — and since I don’t rely on corporate PACs, **I need your help to make history.**
**[Peter, will you help me make history and stand up for the Granite State? body:
Hi there, it’s Nancy Lacore, the Democrat running to flip South Carolina’s First District.
I have a lot of thoughts about what’s been going on with Pete Hegseth.
Not only did he remove me from my position as Chief of the Navy Reserve after 35 years of service, but he’s actively undermining the foundation of our military.
Hegseth has fired more than a dozen senior military officers, including an Army chief of staff and two other generals who were ousted recently.
And now, he’s waging a war with Iran that could put our national security and countless American lives on the line.
That kind of behavior isn’t just destabilizing – it’s dangerous.
Now more than ever, we need leadership that’s rooted in honor, service, and respect. And that’s exactly why I’m running for Congress in South Carolina’s First District.
If we’re going to flip this seat and take back a Democratic House Majority, I need your help. Can you make a split donation of $25 or whatever you can, to Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
DONATE NOW TO HELP NANCY FLIP THIS SEAT! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
I’ll be honest, folks, I’m concerned.
While global tensions rise, the last thing we need is reckless leadership that’s willing to gamble with American lives.
We need steady, experienced leaders who are focused on delivering results – not inciting chaos, playing political games, and putting their own interests above the nation’s.
And I’m running for Congress to restore that kind of leadership – but we have a long road ahead of us to flip this seat and restore some accountability to Washington.
This is one of the most competitive races in the country, and it could decide control of the House. So I need all hands on deck to win. So I have to humbly ask: Will you split $25 today to support Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]

subject: Every mile is worth it 👠
body:
I love talking to people across the state.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi Peter,
One of my favorite parts of this campaign is getting on the road and chatting with Texans face-to-face.
Sometimes, my schedule is so packed that I barely have time to throw the absolute essentials into my bag before racing out of HQ.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260607_1_road.hnoFH9&refcode=em20260607-1283&amount=5&t=1&akid=1283%2E299639%2EI4NV27)
These days, I’m visiting more and more places — whether I’m heading down to South Texas, over to Galveston, up north in Tyler, or out to West Texas.
**But every mile is worth it, Peter.** Because everywhere I go, I hear the same thing.
Texans are tired of paying more while Greg Abbott’s billionaire donors get richer.
They’re tired of attacks on public schools, healthcare, and basic rights.
They’re ready for a governor who actually fights for working families — and they’re excited to join our movement.
Every dollar raised on emails like these helps keep us on the road, talking to voters, and building the campaign it will take to win.

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240891%2E444211%2EWssyq1)
Einstein’s definition of insanity is doing the same thing the same way and expecting a different result.
If we’re serious about winning political power in Texas, it’s crazy to keep pursuing the same tired tactics and hope that somehow this time we’ll pull through.
Is paying people to make phone calls or knock on doors going to make the difference in 2026 if it didn’t every year before now?
Are expensive TV ads (where the consultants who pitch them take a big percentage of what’s spent) going to convince young Texans to get off the couch, go down to the courthouse, get registered and vote?
That’s why Powered by People is organized around doing things differently, taking risks, and iterating until we find what works.
In 2024 we departed from our “registration only” model, where our volunteers would help Texans register and then leave it to them to navigate the toughest voter suppression regime in the country on their own, and took a chance on registering students on college campuses and then personally staying in touch with them throughout the election cycle to make sure that they voted.
This had never been done, and we weren’t sure it was going to work. It took a lot of labor, a lot of volunteers, and a lot of resources to pull off. But at the end of the day, the nearly 30,000 young voters that we met in person and personally stayed in touch with turned out at a rate of over 79%. That’s twice the rate for this same demographic statewide.
This year we’re expanding this successful program to reach more than 100,000 voters. But we’re not stopping there. We’re also running innovative, and yes, unproven, programs that continue to push the standard for excellence in organizing.
One new program seeks to register people who’ve just moved to Texas and update registrations for those moving from one part of Texas to another, all while personally staying in touch with these hundreds of thousands of Democratic movers.
Another program has our volunteers at concerts and shows across the state, meeting voters and future voters where they are to help them get registered and to stay in touch with them until we can confirm they’ve voted.
And yet another teams up with the state party to connect with low-propensity Democrats who are eligible to vote by mail, helping them to navigate the process, secure their ballot, and ensure their vote is counted.
[**If you agree that we’ve got to try new things to reach the voters who will decide these upcoming elections, if you want to support the volunteers and organizers who are pushing the limit of what is possible in Texas, please donate today.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260607.uxTS6L&refcode=ema20260607-240891&t=3&akid=240891%2E444211%2EWssyq1)
[****](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260607.uxTS6L&refcode=ema20260607-240891&t=4&akid=240891%2E444211%2EWssyq1)
**[Donate $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260607.uxTS6L&refcode=ema20260607-240891&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=240891%2E444211%2EWssyq1)**
Your help makes this work, and our success, possible.
Beto

| Friends - I have some exciting news!

subject: Skepticism
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1473%2E1086043%2EH_VtAE)
Peter, I want to talk to the skeptics.
I get it. Politics has let a lot of people down. The cynicism is earned.
But here's what I've learned: skepticism is important, _as long as you make it your companion and not your captor._
I don't come from a political family. I don't think in political terms. I think in terms of results. And results are what we've delivered in Maryland.
Homicides down. Energy bills lower. Teacher vacancies cut in half. $10 billion in new private investment.
I'm not asking you to give up your skepticism. I'm asking you to channel it into something that actually changes things.
**[Can you chip in $5, or whatever you can today, and help us continue to deliver results for the people of Maryland?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260607-1.CBzjlm&refcode=em-20260607-1&t=2&akid=1473%2E1086043%2EH_VtAE)**

The most powerful thing a skeptic can do is prove the cynics wrong.
– Wes Moore

Then Trump got elected _again._

| **D-Day Honored**
---
Yesterday, June 6th, was the 82nd anniversary of D-Day. We thought of the brave Allied forces who descended upon Normandy and changed the direction of WWII on the European front away from fascism.
---
General Eisenhower, later President Eisenhower, was largely responsible for the planning, execution, and success of the Normandy invasion.
---
In Gettysburg, part of our beautiful 13th Congressional District, we not only celebrate the history of Union soldiers changing the tide of the Civil War for Good, we honor President General Eisenhower who ran Camp Holt during WWI and retired after his presidency here as well.
---
And so, in a small way, I, along with campaign manager Jack Stansbury, honored both the man and the anniversary by volunteering with the Friends of Gettysburg today to maintain the beloved battlefield where brave Americans fought for Abolition, preservation of the Union, and Democracy.
---
Many thanks to the Friends of Gettysburg for the opportunity to do so and for lunch. I also had the honor to meet Barbara Finfrock, one of the founders of the Friends of Gettysburg.
