| | | |
---
Peter,
At the end of this message, I’m going to ask you to chip in $5 to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina. **[If you’re ready to give now, you can use this link to donate.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/13020?amount=5&t=8&akid=1653%2E124072%2EWBOeUn)**
**Otherwise, please let me explain why your support is so important and what could happen without it.**
In 2016, I ran for Governor for the first time.
I was fighting to unseat Republican Governor Pat McCrory. Nobody had defeated an incumbent Governor in North Carolina for more than 150 years, but I knew that we had the team behind us to win and make history.
Throughout the race, multiple election experts were saying it was a “Toss Up.” Poll after poll showed me with a slight – or sometimes even large – lead. The momentum was on our side.
**However, on election night, the race was too close to call.**
I ended that night with a less than 5,000-vote lead – which might sound like a lot but is a razor-thin margin in North Carolina, especially given the 4.6 million ballots cast. It was less than half of 1%.
Governor McCrory didn’t concede. He claimed that there had been voter fraud in our state with no evidence to back it up.
He called for a recount, and over the next month, he and his team continued spreading baseless conspiracy theories and undermining faith in the democratic process.
**Yet on Dec. 5, 2016, democracy won. The recount was wrapped up, and the results were in: We had won the race by 10,277 votes.**
Peter, this current Senate race is starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
Just like in 2016, the momentum today appears to be on our side.
Experts are calling this race a “Toss Up.” Even though President Trump carried North Carolina each of the three times he ran, recent polling shows me statistically tied with his handpicked candidate. Even the experts are saying that this is the best chance for Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat in the country.
Here’s what worries me...
**We could have just as easily lost that race in 2016. Despite all of the winds blowing in our favor, we still only won by 10,277 votes – just 0.22%.**
That’s why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. We cannot give our Republican opponent or the right-wing super PACs supporting him an inch.
**I won in 2016 – in the same election that President Trump first won the presidency – only because of grassroots support from people like you. That’s how I plan to win again, but I need you with me.**
[**Please, Peter: Will you chip in $5, or whatever you can, today to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/13020?amount=5&t=9&akid=1653%2E124072%2EWBOeUn)

Roy Cooper

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

I won this primary because I played offense, and **I’m going to run a relentless full-court press to win this seat in November.**
I don’t take a penny of corporate PAC money. Your support, and your support _alone,_ will help us flip Iowa blue for the first time in more than a decade and take back the Senate Majority.
**[I’m personally asking you to become one of our first General Election Founding Donors by splitting a contribution of $15, $20, $35, or more today. Peter, I’m under no illusions about the work it’ll take to win a battleground Senate race as a Democrat in Iowa. Taking on Joni Ernst, Ashley Hinson, and their billionaire-fueled MAGA Machine will be a beast of a challenge — physically, mentally, financially.
But I’m not your average career politician. I’ve won back-to-back victories in deep red Trump country. Polls show me either tied with or one point ahead of my official Republican opponent, Ashley Hinson.
**This election will be a nail-biter, and it starts right now.**
We have **149 days** to bring independents and conservatives into our Prairie Populist coalition; to overcome over $40 million in spending from MAGA megadonors; and to let the world know that working-class Americans own the future.
Ads, statewide tours, and campaign infrastructure don’t come cheap, and our campaign coffers are nearly empty after a hard-fought and high-cost primary victory.

**A NOTE FROM TEAM DUNN**
Harry doesn't like asking for help, but right now, he needs it. More than $5 MILLION in dark money is flooding into this race, and we're falling behind. **[Can you chip in a few dollars before midnight?](https://substack.com/redirect/d83b0112-aac5-49bc-967a-36de000bdd07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/d83b0112-aac5-49bc-967a-36de000bdd07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Hey, Harry here.
I just wanted to say... **THANK YOU**.
If you're reading this, you're committed to defending our democracy -- and I don't take that lightly. It means everything to have people like you in this fight.
In case we haven't met: **I 'm Harry Dunn, Democrat and former Capitol Police Officer running for Congress in Maryland's 5th District.**
On January 6th, I wasn't watching the attack on the Capitol from a TV screen. I was there. I stood on the front lines as Donald Trump's rioters stormed the building, threatened my fellow officers, and tried to overturn a free and fair election. I put my body between them and our democracy -- because that's what I swore an oath to do.
Now, I'm ready to take that same commitment to Congress. Not to score points. Not to make speeches. To hold Donald Trump and his enablers accountable -- and to fight for the working families of Maryland's 5th District every single day.
But this is one of the most competitive primaries in the country, and dark money groups are spending over **$5 MILLION** to boost my opponents. TV ads are airing across the district -- and we just launched our first ad.
Ballots are dropping in Maryland right now. Voters are making up their minds. And every hour we can't stay on the air is an hour our opponents are defining this race on their terms.
We're just **3% AWAY** from hitting the goal that keeps us on the air and in front of voters. If just 3 people from your area chip in, we'll crush that goal.
#### [That's why I'm asking: ](https://substack.com/redirect/d83b0112-aac5-49bc-967a-36de000bdd07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Will you be one of the Loyal Democrats I'm counting on to make a grassroots donation today? Every dollar gets us one step closer to winning this race!](https://substack.com/redirect/d83b0112-aac5-49bc-967a-36de000bdd07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/d83b0112-aac5-49bc-967a-36de000bdd07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thanks again,
H. Dunn

subject: They didn't think we'd make it this far.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Brown for New Hampshire, Inc
body:
Peter,

I just officially filed to run, and it's because of people like you that we've
made it this far.

I've been thinking about what I'd say when this day finally came.

I've been in this arena before. I know what a Senate campaign feels like. I
know what it takes to win, and I know what it takes to serve.

But this feels different.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/filing-email-afs/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_afs&utm_campaign=20260603_filing-day-email_sb&xuno=525334333232&utm_term=aegean&xunv=aegean&xutm=02002901>

LET’S DO THIS
<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/filing-email-afs/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_afs&utm_campaign=20260603_filing-day-email_sb&xuno=525334333232&utm_term=aegean&xunv=aegean&xutm=02002901>
This isn't about a title. It isn't about a resume. I'm coming back because I
genuinely love this state, and I'm watching it get shortchanged by people who
see it as a stepping stone.

New Hampshire deserves better than that.

I've driven every back road, shaken every hand, sat across from enough
kitchen tables to know what people are actually worried about. These aren't
abstractions to me.

They're my neighbors.

And when I was in the Senate, I fought every single day for hardworking
Americans.

I want to do that again.
<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/filing-email-afs/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_afs&utm_campaign=20260603_filing-day-email_sb&xuno=525334333232&utm_term=aegean&xunv=aegean&xutm=02002901>

This campaign was built by real supporters, not Washington money, not party
insiders. That means everything to me.

This is a huge milestone, but the real work starts now. Can you chip in $25,
$50, or whatever you can to help us build on this moment?
<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/filing-email-afs/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_afs&utm_campaign=20260603_filing-day-email_sb&xuno=525334333232&utm_term=aegean&xunv=aegean&xutm=02002901>
LET’S DO THIS

Let's finish what we started.

— Scott

# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2351%2E5691347%2EVgzrBO)

Hi Peter, it’s Jon Ossoff.
Five years ago, Georgia sent the young Jewish son of an immigrant and a Black pastor who holds Dr. King's pulpit at Ebenezer Baptist Church to the U.S. Senate — winning the Senate majority for Democrats.
And this year, our country is counting on us to win here again. Because only by regaining Congressional power can we stop the chaos and corruption of the Trump administration.
So if you’re ready to stop MAGA and restore checks and balances, please chip in what you can to support my campaign here in Georgia.
**Here’s the link to donate:[https://act.electjon.com/go/donate](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.cWQ5pb&refcode=em260607-2-f&t=2&akid=2351%2E5691347%2EVgzrBO)**
Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for the Senate — and why these midterm elections are even more urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, Trump's rule reminds me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
I ran for Senate in Georgia because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency, and to confront the corruption that made his rise possible. We defeated him, and I won.
But now, this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history. This President has:
* Tried to jail elected leaders of the opposition and prosecute Americans who have defied or criticized him.

* Allowed masked federal agents to kick down Americans’ doors without so much as a warrant from a judge, assault and even kill Americans with apparent license from the very top.

* Used the office of the Presidency to enrich his family in a way we have never, ever seen in American history.

**This is not a drill, and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, this moment is the test of our lifetimes.**
The only way to dig ourselves out of this chaos is absolute victory in the midterms.
And just like last time, I can’t do it alone.
So I’m asking:
[**Please, make a contribution to my reelection campaign today, of $5 or any amount that works for you.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.cWQ5pb&refcode=em260607-2-f&t=3&akid=2351%2E5691347%2EVgzrBO)

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260607-fires-rs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260607-fires-rs]
FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260607-fires-rs]
This is the governing body overseeing the National Science Foundation, one of the most important scientific institutions in the United States — and he fired all of them. At once.
The National Science Board exists for a reason. It oversees billions in federal research funding, advises Congress on science policy, and helps ensure taxpayer dollars support real, evidence-based innovation.
Now that independence is being stripped away.
Let me say this clearly: When political leaders start dismantling independent science institutions, it doesn’t just hurt scientists. It hurts all of us — because that means fewer medical breakthroughs, less climate research, slower progress on cancer treatments, degraded pandemic preparedness, and more.
As a microbiologist and educator, take it from me: Science only works when it is allowed to be independent, transparent, and guided by evidence — not politics.
But what we’re seeing now is a systematic effort to replace expertise with loyalty, and it’s happening at the highest levels of government.
This is exactly why I’m running for Congress. Because we need leaders who will defend science and protect vital institutions like the NSF.
But I can’t take on that fight alone. We’re heading into a critical stretch of this campaign, and we need the resources to compete against entrenched interests that are perfectly comfortable ignoring science. So I’m asking you: Can you chip in $10 or whatever you can today to help me fight for science, facts, and the future of research in America? When we let science lead, people thrive. Let’s put facts back in charge — and build a Congress that reflects reason, reality, and hope.

I’ve spent my life fixing things that are broken.
On the factory floor.
In the Navy.
In the National Guard.
And right now, there’s nothing more broken than the United States Senate.
Washington isn’t working for people like us anymore. It’s working for billionaires, lobbyists, and corporations that write the rules for themselves — and leave the rest of us footing the bill.
I’m Dan Osborn, and I’m running for Senate to fix Washington. Please, chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can right now to help me → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
DONATE TODAY TO DEFEAT MAGA EXTREMISM! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
I’m not a career politician. I’m an industrial mechanic from Omaha, a former union leader who took on Kellogg’s to protect my coworkers’ wages and benefits, and a guy who knows what it means to work 80-hour weeks just to keep a middle-class life together.
And I’m running as an independent because I don’t owe either party a damn thing.
I owe you.
I’ll fight to cut taxes for working families, protect Social Security, stand up for family farms, and finally pass Right to Repair so corporations stop ripping people off just to fix what they own.
But I can’t do this alone. The same billionaires who broke Washington are going to spend whatever it takes to keep it that way.
So I’m asking: Will you chip in $10, $25, or anything you can right now to help us build a campaign that answers to working people — not the powerful? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-osborn]
Let's fix this.
—Dan Osborn
